header: The people behind every Desiderio release
subheadline: A small, senior team at webconsulting studio covers design, engineering and accessibility. The same people answer your Pro support tickets and run the managed hosting.

members.name: Lea Fischer
members.bio: Owns the 62-component library and the token scale that keeps all 15 presets consistent, including custom presets for client brands.

image.title: Lea Fischer
image.alternative: A woman in her thirties with light-brown hair tied back and a navy blouse.

members.name: Mara Weiss
members.bio: Built the atoms and molecules behind all 244 content elements. She also runs the LTS upgrades for managed-hosting customers.

image.title: Mara Weiss
image.alternative: A woman in her late thirties with a dark-brown bob and an olive-green knit top.

members.name: Noah Ritter
members.bio: Reviews every element for accessible markup. The contrast checks for all 15 presets are his, and they pass after every theme switch.

image.title: Noah Ritter
image.alternative: A man in his thirties with short dark-blond hair, a trimmed beard and a navy sweater.
